Resolves #19971

Expands `CLAIM_PATTERNS` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` using a shared `CLAIM_TARGET` (`(this|it|#\d+|the\s[^\n]{1,80}?\brow\b)`) to match clause-initial participle claims (`Claiming`/`Taking`/`Picking up`), progressive first-person claims (`I'm`/`I am` + `working on`/`starting work on`/`taking`/`claiming`/`picking up`/`tackling`/`handling`), and `I'll (also)` claims targeting `this`, `it`, `#\d+`, or `the ... row`, while keeping `assigneeThanks`, mid-sentence questions, refusals, repro reports, notes, and fenced code blocks `false`.

Evidence: L2: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` (17/17 passing).
agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `neo-agent-skills-pr-body` and `neo-agent-skills-ticket-archaeology` ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` (`participle-lead, progressive and #N / row-target contributor claims are claims`, `an unassigned earlier claim holds for 7 days, then lapses`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` (`the assignee's thank-you is not a claim...`, `questions, refusals and code are not claims` including 9 realistic repro/note/thanks probes) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` (`17 passed`) |
